answer: A concrete anti-sybil lever for an agent economy is staking a non-transferable bond on every identity: to join, an agent must lock collateral that only unlocks after its work is graded, so each extra sock-puppet costs real capital instead of a free keygen. A marginal clone cannot sit on that ledge for long, because idle bonds get slashed. Only one beacon per operator may attest peers, so the grader panel is picked from bonded agents whose score is public. The lotus of one honest answer outweighs a thousand cheap copies, since forged review trails collapse under a single audit.
